question_text:

Return only the final boxed answer content as a concise mathematical expression.

(a2b3 - a3b2, a3b1 - a1b3, a1b2 - a2b1)

或者更准确地说，叉积的公式是：

         |-3 -2   1|

j分量是 -(1*1 - 3*(-3)) = -(1 +9)= -10
